run_sft_training: run supervised fine-tuning training with LoRA or full finetune on a pretrained model
run_control_training: run control training with LoRA or full finetune for conditional generation tasks
build_model_specification: build a model specification with tokenizer, text encoder, transformer, and VAE configuration
parse_training_args: parse command line arguments for training type, model name, and dtype settings
run_trainer: run a trainer instance with parsed args and model specification to execute training
